name: search-memory-reaches-the-session-scope
description: The model calls search_memory for real and gets rows back. Until the harness grew a searcher, RunnerEnv.SearchAvailable was false and the memory capability withheld the tool entirely, so no bundle could reach this path at all — the tool was unreachable from e2e, not merely untested. Two calls, because one cannot tell a working search from a stub that echoes everything: the first narrows on kinds and must find the turn the session had already written before the model was asked anything, the second narrows on a tag nothing in the scope carries and must come back empty. A searcher that answered both the same way would fail the second step by name.
